279452214.description:
Two small hard plastic costume dolls in regional folk dress, each sealed in a clear cylindrical plastic tube. One doll wears a yellow felt hat with a yellow satin apron dress and braided black hair. The other wears a straw hat with red pom poms, a red dress with lace trim and a black bow, and stands on a round cardboard base. A paper label on the tube of the yellow doll reads Schwarzwald.

Condition: Age discoloration and staining on the yellow dress. Scuffs and creases in the plastic tubes. Small paper tag attached to the red doll. Light dust throughout.

279449749.description:
Set of two polished agate geode halves that work as bookends. The cut faces show white and clear crystal formations with a peach colored center and a tan outer band. The rough backs are tinted teal blue and the bottoms are flat so each piece stands upright. Each piece is a natural stone, so color and pattern differ slightly from one half to the other.

Condition: Rough natural edges along the outer rim. Small white chalky patches on the rim of one piece. A small square of paper residue is on the base of one piece. No cracks seen.

279891258.description: This vintage glass insulator measures 3x3x4 and is made of light pink glass. It features a metal insert on the top designed for mounting or securing to a pole or wire. The glass body is cylindrical with a stepped design. The insulator shows signs of wear consistent with age but remains in generally good used condition. There are no visible brand or model markings. This item was commonly used on telegraph, telephone, or electrical power lines.
